verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact directly with Trigger.dev projects. It also includes tools for conversing with chat agents from Claude Code, Cursor and Windsurf, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence of the full tool set and setup/auth flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Trigger.dev MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server enables AI assistants to interact directly with your Trigger.dev projects.
The Trigger.dev MCP server includes tools for having conversations with your chat agents directly from AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and others.
official MCP server documented at https://trigger.dev/docs/mcp-introduction
